test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A nominated member of a House shall be disqualified for being a member of the House if he joins any political party after the expiry of __________from the date on which he takes his seat.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Six Months__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A Nominated member of any house of the Indian Parliament shall be disqualified for being a member of the house if he joins any political party after the expiry of **Six Months.**
 
• This Section comes under **Disqualification on grounds of defection.**
 
• States that a nominated member shall be disqualified if he/she joins any political party after six months from the date he/she takes his seat.
 
• This Anti-Defection law was passed by the Indian Parliament in the year 1985 by the 52nd Amendment of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This schedule does not bar court intervention under the following articles of the Constitution of India.

 
 
• ​Article 32.
 
• Article 226.
 
• Article 137.
